Q1
Which exact part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Workflow file(s) under `.github/workflows/` — reply with the exact workflow filename(s) or pipeline phase(s). (RECOMMENDED)
B. Script/prompt/helper file(s) under `scripts/` or `prompts/` — reply with the exact file path(s). (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs/metadata files (`README.md`, `agents.md`, etc.) — reply with the exact file path(s). (RECOMMENDED)
D. Repo-wide/general improvement pass — this is broad and may require re-clarification.
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a concrete bug or failure — include current behavior, expected behavior, and any failing issue/PR/workflow run id. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change a specific behavior — describe the desired behavior and when it should be considered correct. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve reliability / performance / cost — name the bottleneck and how success should be measured.
D. Cleanup only (docs/readability/maintainability) — name what is currently wrong.
Q3
What acceptance check should planning use?
Choices:
A. Match a specific failing example — provide the issue/PR/workflow run number or exact reproduction steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Meet a specific before/after rule you provide — describe the observable result after the change. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Best-effort improvement with no concrete acceptance check — higher risk of a mismatch.
